meta.title: Video operator
meta.description: Create narrated landscape and portrait videos, covers and subtitles with local GPT-SoVITS and FFmpeg. Optionally render local MuDuo Live2D motions, expressions and narration lip sync with Core, Playwright and Chromium. Create as MuDuo and enforce landscape-only Bilibili and portrait-only Douyin publishing, checking displayed orientation before preview and execution. Preview and publish to Bilibili and Douyin, inspect videos, read and reply to comments, and review performance data. Start with video_operator_guide and configure Python, bili and a private Douyin credential file. Requires bili-agent login or authorized Douyin OAuth scopes. Conversation tools and native plugin configuration are provided; online platform calls require valid credentials.
